title: Cragbeast Queen (seasonal)
summary: The seasonal Cragbeast Queen favors piercing weapons and calls nearby creatures to her defense.
overview: The seasonal Cragbeast Queen favors piercing weapons and calls nearby creatures to her defense.

sections.title: Encounter guide
bullets: Use piercing or two-handed piercing attacks where possible. The script increases those damage types while sharply reducing blunt, slashing, archery and throwing damage.
Every forty-five seconds in combat, the Queen draws idle creatures within a wide surrounding area onto her top-hate target.
Clear the nearby shore before the pull and keep an add tank ready for the call-for-help emote.
Leaving combat stops the repeated assist calls.

notes: Reviewed against quest source only; encounter behavior, database tuning and availability have not been verified in a live zone. Tactical advice is inferred from the scripted mechanics.
Version 200 is explicitly supported for the seasonal instance. The ability timer started by the script has no matching ability handler, so no additional timed special attack is claimed.
Resolve the encounter NPC template ID before publication; the reviewed files do not identify it unambiguously.
